name: CySOC_DCSync_Respond
author: CySOC
description: Evaluate a DCSync case against the user+host whitelist stored in Consul KV. Stable identifiers (Microsoft Defender device id, directory object id) are read from the MicrosoftDefender enrichment analyzer reports attached to the observables, so any spelling of the same user/host matches the same whitelist entry. All pairs whitelisted: closes the case as a false positive. Any pair not whitelisted: optionally disables the user's Entra account and/or isolates the source device (only the non-whitelisted user/device pairs), then closes the case as a true positive only if every attempted action succeeded — otherwise the case is left open. Fails without closing when an observable lacks enrichment. The decision is always logged to a 'CySOC/Log' task on the case.

configurationItems.name: TheHive API key
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key with permission to read observables and close cases

configurationItems.name: Consul KV whitelist
configurationItems.description: Exact Consul KV path to the whitelist key (a single key holding a YAML document, not a directory prefix). Leave empty to skip the whitelist check — every pair is then treated as not whitelisted (true positive, case stays open)

configurationItems.name: Close on false positive
configurationItems.description: Close the case automatically when every user+host pair is whitelisted

configurationItems.name: Azure tenant ID
configurationItems.description: Azure AD tenant id. Required only if any true-positive containment action is enabled

configurationItems.name: Azure app client ID
configurationItems.description: Azure AD app registration (client) id, granted Microsoft Graph 'User.EnableDisableAccount.All' + 'User.ReadWrite.All' + 'User.RevokeSessions.All' and a Defender for Endpoint machine-action permission (e.g. 'Machine.Isolate'). Required only if any true-positive containment action is enabled

configurationItems.name: Azure app client secret
configurationItems.description: Client secret for the app registration above. Required only if any true-positive containment action is enabled

configurationItems.name: Disable user on true positive
configurationItems.description: On true-positive, disable the Entra account of every non-whitelisted user via Microsoft Graph (requires User.EnableDisableAccount.All + User.Read.All)

configurationItems.name: Force password reset on true positive
configurationItems.description: On true-positive, force a password change at next sign-in for every non-whitelisted user via Microsoft Graph (requires User.ReadWrite.All)

configurationItems.name: Revoke sessions on true positive
configurationItems.description: On true-positive, revoke all active sign-in sessions (refresh tokens + session cookies) for every non-whitelisted user via Microsoft Graph (requires User.RevokeSessions.All or User.ReadWrite.All)

configurationItems.name: Isolate device on true positive
configurationItems.description: On true-positive, isolate every non-whitelisted source device via Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

configurationItems.name: Full isolation
configurationItems.description: Isolation scope when 'Isolate device on true positive' is enabled: False (default, recommended) = Selective; True = Full network isolation
